accepted_readable_boundaries.classification: User-approved readable extreme boundary; old strict geometric assertion is outside current acceptance
accepted_readable_boundaries.user_instruction: 长文件夹标题之类的极端边界，只要可读就可以认为成功。
accepted_readable_boundaries.visual_review: Readable Chinese with ellipsis; clock readable. Native snapshot at image capture has title.left85, clock.right82. Later separate geometric reads are not the user criterion.

native_input_retest.original_result: First native pen tap left the visible Country menu open and locale unchanged; no guest exception captured. Original operation is not a pass.
native_input_retest.root_cause: unconfirmed input registration/timing; no product cause claimed
native_input_retest.qa_change: Require two native menu viewCObject ready observations before picking an item; same fixed S0 and candidate35.
native_input_retest.retest_result: China-USA-China actual native selection, two ready observations before taps, original Roman and CJK font assertions passed; original failed input retained without cause attribution.

reviewed_changes: Font.newt normal exception reporting now preserves CurrentException.error/message/data and diagnostic phase
ContentDisplay.newt adds failure-phase context and shared-view operation/index/class diagnostics
styledTextDrawing returns EnsureInternal(pieces), owning the complete generated list; text construction, glyph lookup, font routing, metrics and geometry calculations are unchanged
candidate_change_impact_review.limits: Object ownership is a functional lifecycle change. Historical Lite main stages are explicitly identified as candidate30 evidence; final35 adds fresh 20-phase Lite matrix, 28 pixel controls, ordinary hot reinstall and restart cases. Full main uses final35 from S0. This is a change-impact review, not a claim that every historical test was rerun.
